Liz M.: Heads-up — vendor lab flagged thermal/power constraints for mixed racks (H100 + Gaudi). Might affect marketplace slotting windows.
Devon P.: Which exact configs are impacted?
Liz M.: Vendor note: sustained power capping when H100 or H200 are paired with Gaudi in the same PSU zone; spikes during long-context loads.
Amar K.: Need their numbers for the ops matrix.
infra-bot: ATTACHMENT: vendor-power-report-Q1.pdf
Liz M.: Quick summary: H100 sustained ~350W, H200 ~420W, MI300 ~450W; Gaudi lower per-card but reduces PSU thermal headroom in mixed setups.
Natalie R.: So some rack combos reduce available GPU density — may force staggered onramp waves.
Sam H. (hw-partner): Confirmed from SI tests — PSUs throttled mixing these SKUs. Recommendation: separate power zones or lower slot density in mixed racks.
Devon P.: Proposed marketplace fallbacks:
- A: Dedicated racks per SKU (safe, higher cost)
- B: Mixed racks with reduced slot density (cheaper)
- C: Region-specific SKU gating for staged rollouts
Amar K.: Update the compute compatibility matrix and the SI onboarding playbook.
Natalie R.: Can we surface a banner: "density-limited — expected reduced slot availability" for affected SKUs?
Devon P.: Yes. I'll own UI banner if infra provides a flag.
Liz M.: @infra-bot can you run a power sweep and expose a boolean flag in /compatibility?
infra-bot: Scheduled power profile sweep today. Will publish /compatibility/power_flag.json if anomalies found.
Sam H. (hw-partner): I'll provide rack diagrams + sample slotting matrix.
Sam H. (hw-partner): ```recommended_slotting_v1:
H100: 350W -> max 2 units per 48U zone
H200: 420W -> max 1 unit per 48U zone
MI300: 450W -> isolated PSU recommended, 1 per rack
Gaudi: 300W -> up to 3 units with thermal zoning
Mixed (H100+Gaudi): reduce H100 to 1 per zone```
Amar K.: Map these to SKU flags: "isolated_psu", "reduced_density", "embargo_window".
Natalie R.: Partnerships/marketing will need embargo windows for any joint announcements referencing capacity. Avoid comms implying GA in density-limited zones.
Devon P.: Action items:
- Sam H.: final rack diagrams + checklist by EOD Thu
- infra-bot: finish power sweep and publish flag endpoint
- Devon P.: add UI banner and SKU flag hooks (ETA Fri)
- Liz M.: update SI playbook + canary plan (ETA next Tue)
Liz M.: Proposing a 2-week canary in one region with reduced density flag; collect tail-latency and thermal metrics.
Sam H. (hw-partner): We'll provide an SI engineer for the canary.
Amar K.: Also add a small note in the console rollout dialog explaining auto-fallback to compatible variants when capacity constrained.
Devon P.: Copy for dialog: "If capacity constrained, requests will automatically fall back to compatible variants — see docs."
infra-bot: Power sweep completed. Flag endpoint published: https://internal-api.company/compatibility/power_flag.json
Liz M.: Got it. Reviewing matrix tomorrow 9am PT invite incoming.
Natalie R.: I'll prepare embargo dates and partner comms draft after canary results.
Amar K.: Closing unless new blockers. Thanks all.
